d:
Andy Spinks takes on a risky job, hauling a pump down to the river in his massive excavator to get water flowing to the Hoffman crew's washplant. With the water supply restored, the team is ready to get back to mining. Meanwhile, Todd Hoffman uses dynamite to blast through giant boulders, Parker Schnabel battles a flood, and Tony Beets takes his massive power barge up the freezing Yukon River. With winter closing in, can the miners hit their gold targets in time?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 20, on Discovery Channel India.
